page.layout: One title block at the top, full width (NOMINA VICORUM and the lines below it). Below it, one column on the left: a heading "AD OCCIDENTEM Eæ amnis." followed by a list of place names, one per line, ending with the names under "INTER EAM & TIAMMAM" and "REIDERWOLDE". A vertical rule runs down the right edge of the column. No marginal notes in this part.; One column of short lines below a title fragment at the top; a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: NOMINA VICOR
CORUM,
DVLLAE[?]
AD OCCIDENTEM Eæ amnis.
main_text.l: Wester Reida, in cujus reliquijs nunc castellū militare
INTER EAM & TIAMMAM amnes, itidem ad Occidentem Eæ.
REIDERWOLDE, ubi duo templa, in quorum altero Canonicatus: vicus maximus. Palmaer, cœnobium præmonstrat.
main_text.head: RUM, ET LO- Q U O S RTVS fit.
AD ORIENTEM Ex.

page.notes: Left and right edges of the scan are cut in this part, so the end of the title line ("VICOR…", "DVLLAE…", "sinus hau…") and the right-hand column are incomplete. Doubtful readings: "DVLLAE" (last letters), "Assock" (long s pair), "Oikeweer" (initial sign), "Cappeldcbeerda" as printed. The title fragment at the top is printed in spaced capitals and is only partly visible; "fit." is its last word. "Ofter REIDE" is printed with REIDE in capitals, and "Thorum," is italic while "forum egregium" is roman. The Digitised-by-Google mark at the lower right is left out.
